name: Nassau National Cable
old_description: Fill out the form with your project details, and we’ll help you every step of the way.
about:
Nassau National Cable is based in Great Neck, New York. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The firm operates as a wire and cable distributor, supplying wholesale cable for large-scale projects and offering customized fiber optic cable solutions. Its product range includes THHN/THWN-2 building wire, underground residential distribution (URD) cable, overhead service drop cable, mobile home feeder cable, SER cable, UF-B underground feeder, and NM-B cable. The company emphasizes project engineering support, inviting customers to submit project details for tailored assistance. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not disclosed.

Nassau National Cable serves industries such as solar energy, wind power, marinas, mining, data centers, and general building construction. Its customers include electrical contractors, project engineers, and procurement teams managing large infrastructure projects. The website highlights project-specific categories for solar, wind, marina, mining, and data center applications.

The company positions itself on engineering-driven project support, using the tagline 'Engineering Your Project With Confidence' and promising to assist customers at every step. No specific origin story or unique founding mission is stated on its website.
